rationale: Visible evidence supports the assertion: the metric_output reports exit_code=0, ce_selection_gate_passed=false, CFC-only regret@3=0.044697468910847644 and cost=13.833333333333334, while LoopCert-only, family-balanced blend, and risk-calibrated blend have lower regret@3=0.03223671717595801 but higher cost=16.666666666666668, and Pareto-front has lower regret@3=0.03313607480648891 but higher cost=16.5. The transform_script evidence states the eligible CE-gate contenders are LoopCert-only, Pareto-front, risk-calibrated blend, and family-balanced blend and that a contender must beat CFC on both regret and cost; reproduction_log and sanity_check evidence record the downstream gate closed because the CE selection gate did not beat CFC-only on both axes. This directly supports prioritizing reduced LoopCert-family cost-to-contain while preserving regret gains before downstream tests are opened.
